profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at BSC Analytics
profile.summary:
Backend and applied AI systems engineer specializing in the infrastructure between emerging model capabilities and dependable production systems.
I design type-safe APIs, backend platforms, developer tooling, evaluation workflows, and governed agent integrations. Most recently, I architected and prototyped a model-agnostic MCP gateway and shared context plane for permission-aware access to internal engineering systems.
My work spans distributed Go, Python, and TypeScript services, production API architecture, observability, CI/CD, machine learning, LLM evaluation, and developer infrastructure. Across URBN, Trinnex, The Knot Worldwide, and independent AI work, I have repeatedly taken fragile or ambiguous systems and turned them into maintainable, measurable, production-ready platforms.
I am at my best in high-ownership environments where the architecture is still emerging, the problem is not fully defined, and the system needs someone who can see the missing layer before it has a name.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer focused on cloud integrations and the modernization of high-consequence legacy systems within client-embedded consulting engagements.

✦ Build governed cloud infrastructure and automation using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.

✦ Translate complex security, compliance, and operational constraints into reliable, maintainable, and auditable technical solutions.

✦ Partner across engineering and client teams to define measurable outcomes, surface risks early, and carry work through evidence-backed completion.

✦ Apply AI-assisted development responsibly to improve speed, testing, documentation, and quality while maintaining full ownership of the work.

positions.title: Independent Software Engineer | AI Evaluation Contributor
positions.description:
• Design backend infrastructure, automation tooling, and cloud workflows for startups and enterprise clients.
• Build production services in TypeScript, Python, and SQL with an emphasis on clean architecture, reproducibility, testing, and reliability.
• Contribute engineering data, prompt workflow analysis, dataset handling, model evaluation, and performance benchmarking for large language model training and fine-tuning.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led backend and platform development for high-traffic Marketplace systems across a large TypeScript monorepo.
• Architected and prototyped a model-agnostic MCP gateway and shared context plane for governed AI-agent access to internal engineering systems.
• Designed read-only integrations spanning repositories, CI systems, and internal service context to reduce brittle point-to-point connections between coding assistants and enterprise platforms.
• Built production systems with an emphasis on type safety, testing, reliability, performance, documentation, and observable execution.
• Partnered across United States and Spain engineering teams, product, design, and QA to align technical direction and accelerate delivery.
